description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Akali''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] 750 units in the direction of the target enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], dealing magic damage to enemies she passes through. If this hits an enemy, she flips over them to continue the dash up to the normal range but for at least another 150 units.
description.text: Active: Akali dashes 750 units in the direction of the target enemy champion, dealing magic damage to enemies she passes through. If this hits an enemy, she flips over them to continue the dash up to the normal range but for at least another 150 units.

description2.raw: ''Perfect Execution'' can be recast after a 2.5-second static cooldown within 10 seconds of the first activation.

notes.raw: *Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. * With the first cast, '''Akali''' can dash up to a maximum of 900 units if the first enemy she hit was at the maximum dash range. * Casting [[File:Flash.png|20xpx|border|link=Flash|An icon representing Flash]] [[Flash]] during either dashes will interrupt them, but '''Akali''' will deal damage to any enemies she comes in contact with at the new location. ** Enemies already hit by either of ''Perfect Execution's'' casts cannot be affected more than once by the same cast. * [[File:Akali Shuriken Flip.png|20xpx|border|link=Akali#Shuriken Flip|An icon for Akali's ability Shuriken Flip]] [[Akali#Shuriken Flip|Shuriken Flip]] can be used during the initial dash if it is cast after ''Perfect Execution's'' cast time finishes. * This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's stats at the start of cast and does not change dynamically.
notes.text:
Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
With the first cast, Akali can dash up to a maximum of 900 units if the first enemy she hit was at the maximum dash range.
Casting Flash during either dashes will interrupt them, but Akali will deal damage to any enemies she comes in contact with at the new location.
* Enemies already hit by either of Perfect Execution's casts cannot be affected more than once by the same cast.
Shuriken Flip can be used during the initial dash if it is cast after Perfect Execution's cast time finishes.
This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's stats at the start of cast and does not change dynamically.
